# agyn Provider

Provider for Agyn Team API via Gateway.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "agyn" {
  api_url = "https://gateway.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_url` (String) Base URL for the Gateway (e.g., https://gateway.example.com).
